[Feb 2016]

Talks with several mining companies have broken down in Mongolia, following an attempt to open the country up to mining operations. In addition to citizen protests, the Mongolian government refused to bend on it's demands, stating that "...the rich mineral deposits beneath Mongolian soil are just that - Mongolian. We will not allow our homeland to be destroyed so that foreign interests can make money."

The Mongolian government has levied such a high tariff on foreign companies that very few companies are interested. It appears that, unless something changes, Mongolia is going to be responsible for mining its own minerals.
